entries.zh: 落溥？（失意潦倒、地位跌落；或即「落魄／落薄」）；释义存疑
entries.en: to come down in the world, to fall into destitution (sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西文 desmullado a probaeca 不可确解，字「溥」非习用；据对音 lo po 暂拟「落魄／落薄」，语义无法定夺，故低置信。

entries.zh: 落头（低头、垂首）
entries.en: to lower the head; to bow one's head

entries.zh: 落价（降价；货物跌价）
entries.en: to lower the price; (of goods) to fall in price

entries.zh: 落钱（压低价钱、减价）
entries.en: to knock down the price; to lower the sum

entries.zh: 摆（上下摆动、摇摆；如吊灯之升降摆荡）
entries.en: to swing, to sway (of a lamp lowered and raised)

entries.zh: 摆落（以绳悬吊垂放；或谓自城墙缒下）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to let down by rope (as from a wall); sense uncertain
entries.notes: 西文 p[残]elona 处残缺；「城」据 M sia／R cheng 对音推得，所指难定，故低置信。

entries.zh: 摆旗（降旗、放落旗帜）
entries.en: to lower the flag; to haul down

entries.zh: 摆上去（放上去、搁上去；与西文所示方向相左，释义存疑）
entries.en: to put up, to place upward (conflicts with the garbled Spanish reading; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西文 firando lo amcon del 不可确解且与汉字「擺上去」方向相反，疑原稿有误，故低置信。

entries.zh: 灾（降灾；灾祸骤降如雷殛；原字「炎／災」存疑）
entries.en: calamity; to come down suddenly like a thunderbolt (character uncertain)
entries.notes: 字形「炎／災」两拟，据对音 chay 与文义当为「災」。

entries.zh: 灾害（灾祸骤至，如陨石风暴之降）
entries.en: calamity, disaster (striking like a falling stone and a storm)
entries.notes: 同前条，字「炎／災」存疑，取「災害」义。

entries.zh: 降（自天骤降；如神明降下，尊者下临）
entries.en: to descend suddenly from heaven (as of God); to come down from high dignity

entries.zh: 降凡（自天降于凡尘、下凡）
entries.en: to descend from heaven to the mortal world (of a deity or Christ)
entries.notes: 字「凡／仜」存疑，且 M/R 末音节 guin 未明，主训依「降凡」常义。

entries.zh: 降下（落下、降下）
entries.en: to come down, to descend

entries.zh: 降世（降生于世间；下凡降世）
entries.en: to come into the world; to descend to the world (of Christ or a deity)

entries.zh: 降痰（化痰下行；西文兼言痰壅气窒）
entries.en: to bring down the phlegm (humoral medicine)
entries.notes: 字「痰／疾」存疑，据西文 flemas 取「痰」。

entries.zh: 降职（贬降职分、黜为下职）
entries.en: to demote; to degrade to a lesser office
entries.notes: 字「職／戓」存疑，据西文 oficio menor 取「職」。

entries.zh: 降临（自天而降；神明降临）
entries.en: to descend from heaven; to come down (advent, of God or Christ)

entries.zh: 覆（俯首低头；覆）
entries.en: to lower the head; to cover over

entries.zh: 覆转（翻跌滚转而下）
entries.en: to come down tumbling, turning over and over
entries.notes: 第二字「彜」疑为「輾」（R 对音 hien 佐证），M 末音节 hu/hù 未明。

entries.zh: 款（俯首至地以示敬爱；诚服归款）
entries.en: to bow the head to the ground in reverence and affection; to submit sincerely
entries.notes: 「款」作俯首致敬义罕见（或取「款服」）；M 第二音节 tan 未明。

entries.zh: 叩（叩首、俯首行礼；敲击）
entries.en: to bow the head; to knock (as in kowtow)
entries.notes: R 官话对音 guen 与「叩」音不合（近「跪」），释义依 L/H/M 三栏。

entries.zh: 叩首（磕头；俯首致敬）
entries.en: to kowtow; to bow the head in reverence
entries.notes: R 对音 guen gien 与「叩首」音不合（近「跪見」），释义依 L/H/M 三栏。
